purpose: Owner-authorized development-only acquisition of official PDFtk for the synthetic native fixture oracle
download_method: Invoke-WebRequest over HTTPS with 30-second timeout; files written only to the unique external cache

extractor.verifier_keyring: Public keyring confined to the owned external cache; no user/system keyring changed
extractor.zip_path_validation: Every entry checked for absolute paths, escape from extraction root, and symbolic-link attributes before extraction; files created with CreateNew
extractor.verification_notes: The publisher key was retrieved from its official HTTPS site and its signature verifies the archive; no independent certification of publisher-key identity is asserted. MD5 alone was not the trust gate. Initial Git gpg imports reported path-format/agent-start errors; the owned public keyring was successfully read by gpgv and signature verification then returned 0. No agent configuration or security setting changed.

extraction.mode: innoextract --list, followed by --extract --output-dir in the owned cache; the PDFtk setup executable was only read as data

pdftk_version_probe.invocation: Direct ProcessStartInfo invocation with ArgumentList, no shell evaluation
pdftk_version_probe.scope: Acquisition/version only; does not prove application merging, fixture correctness, PDF fidelity, PS5.1 execution, or release support

limitations: Official PDFtk installer and extracted executable/library have no Authenticode signature. The installer hash matches Microsoft's independently maintained winget manifest; this is an integrity/provenance check, not a malware-free guarantee.
The extracted engine is x86 running on this x64 Windows host. No 32-bit application-host compatibility claim follows.
The development cache is external and untracked; its availability must be checked on future sessions. No runtime installer or dependency downloader was added.
PowerShell 7.6.5 was used for acquisition; this does not certify the required current supported PowerShell update. Native oracle results are recorded separately by the task owner.
